reviews.title: Calories burned decreases by doing more steps... how??
reviews.text:
I wouldn't feel the need to write a review if there were actually a way to troubleshoot this, but there is no support.

The calorie count is complete nonsense. I go for a run in the morning, and my calorie count is 350 for the day. I go for an evening walk, and somehow my calorie count for the same day has gone down to 300. How am I burning few calories by doing more exercise??

Update: New glitches! I went for a 75 minute jog, but the app claims that it was only 34 minutes... and also that I was going twice as fast as usual. Does not work.

reviews.title: I thought this was the step ap of my dreams…NOT!
reviews.text: When I first got the so installed , I was so happy to have a tool that was straight to the point , simple, user friendly , very minimal permissions. On my first day of walking, I thought it was strange to see it calculated strokes for 5 days prior to me even using the ap. Although odd, I didn’t think it was that big of deal to complain , when I just had to manually adjust the over in total to get my actual count. I was good with that, so I kept using it. It’s truly helped in that aspect and I feel more motivated to walk. Until..I go to share my progress with my grandchild and there is a whole row of images at the bottom lined up of naked men and women in provocative , half naked to naked photos!!!!!! I will be deleting the sp, and reaching out for legal advice on the embarrassment and mental trauma my grandchild endured.
